title: Dispositions: The Outcome of Every Activity | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Every call, text or task ends in some way: nobody answered, the customer asked for a call back, a test drive was booked. A disposition is that outcome. Agents pick one when they complete an activity, an AI conversation picks one when it ends, and the subject flow decides what happens next. This video shows why dispositions exist, how to create them in the CrestApps Contact Center for Orchard Core, and how outcomes let the platform apply a disposition for you.

In this video:
• Why dispositions exist
• Creating a disposition: name, description, outcome and lead status
• What can change after it is saved
• Outcomes the platform applies by itself, such as Number not in service and No answer
• Which disposition the platform uses when a call ends early
• How teams use dispositions
